title: Spinnet Host-Fetched Sections
description: The fetch member of a Detail section, and the section_delivered View Event it may produce, as of Plugin API Level 1. A Detail section {id, title?, text?, fetch} whose fetch is present is a Host-Fetched Section: the Host sends its request, with the Plugin's Credential Uses applied, and either shows the answer it extracts (mode show; the Plugin never sees the response) or hands the response to the script as a section_delivered View Event and shows the text the script answers with (mode deliver). The request is checked again as it is sent: its URL must be https to a host consented for the Plugin, and its headers and Credential Uses follow the https_request rules. A view fetches at most 8 sections; each request has a 15-second budget, redirects included. A section keeps what it fetched while its id and fetch stay the same.

request.description: The https_request input the Host sends. Credential Uses name stored credentials by reference; the Host places or signs them as the request leaves and never shows them to the Plugin. A request the Host would refuse to send fails only its own section.

pointer.description: An RFC 6901 JSON pointer, such as /data/0/text, of at most 512 characters.

fetch.description: What the Host sends for a section, and what it does with the response.

mode.description: show: the Host extracts the answer at pointer and shows it as plain text. deliver: the Host sends the response to the script as a section_delivered View Event and shows the section's text from the view the script answers with.

pointer.description: show only: where the answer, a string, sits in a 2xx JSON response.

error_pointer.description: show only: where a message sits in a failed JSON response.

status_messages.description: show only: the message to show for a failed status, which wins over error_pointer.

cache.description: Whether the same request may be answered from the Host's last answer to it, kept in memory for 10 minutes among at most 50 answers and forgotten whenever a grant changes. Only a 2xx answer is kept.

response.description: The https_request result: the status, only the content-type, content-language and retry-after headers, and the body as text of at most 128 KiB.

section_delivered.description: The View Event a deliver section's response arrives as. It waits its turn behind the session's other events. The script answers it as any other event; the section then shows its text from the view the script answers with, and is not fetched again while its fetch is unchanged. A request that fails before a response arrives is shown as the section's failure and delivers nothing.
